title: Finite constant direct images generate the affine etale derived category
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, and work with the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(S_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ of constant-coefficient module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], on small representatives in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For each finite morphism $p:T\to S$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], let $\Lambda_T$ denote the constant rank-one module sheaf [def-kun-constant-sheaf] in degree zero, and use the total right derived direct image $Rp_*$ of [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Then the smallest strictly full triangulated subcategory of $D(S_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$ closed under all set-indexed coproducts in the coefficient universe and containing $Rp_*\Lambda_T$ for every such $p$ is all of $D(S_{\mathrm{Et}},\Lambda)$. No Noetherian, torsion, or finite-cardinality hypothesis is imposed on $\Lambda$ or $S$.

source.place: Tag 05K0, lemma-quasi-finite-separated-pass-through-finite: agent-derived generation consequence of the finite compactification of affine etale objects. The sheaf and telescope arguments are given in the delivery report, using etale-cohomology.tex extension by zero and finite direct-image stalks.
